title: Clear recovery connection state when cancellation forwarding loses transport
outcome: Clear recovery connection state when cancellation forwarding loses transport
acceptance: When cancellation forwarding fails with IOException, the matching failed recovery connection is invalidated and HasEstablishedConnection becomes false while caller cancellation is preserved; successful cancellation forwarding retains its established connection, and a concurrent replacement connection is not cleared.

completion.summary: Matching-client invalidation now handles cancellation-forwarding transport failures as well as ordinary exchange loss, preserving caller cancellation through disposal errors, retaining successful forwarding, distinguishing shutdown-only OCE and preserving a concurrent replacement. Corrected RED and six independent mutation controls are archived; final full suite includes decisive synthetic cancellation state tests and existing real-process 4/0/4 exit controls. This is compositional evidence, not an end-to-end cancellation-failure process-exit reproduction. Final complete gates and fresh Codex/Claude full-union review passed. New Low CLI test/doc follow-up is tracked separately as w-129583275429. Implemented and reviewed; not committed or pushed.
